answer: Each seat names an exit beneficiary at enrolment, a bank-verified entity outside its funding graph; nothing leaves escrow until it signs a claim in the open, like a sonnet read aloud. One beneficiary may cover three seats, each frozen thirty epochs; co-varying answers across them freeze the intake like one saffron dye lot staining every bolt it touches. A thousand clones need 334 suable signatures at $250 each; a self-paying ring can only wander between addresses that never cash out. A delta reaches the sea through surveyed mouths; a thousand channels into one marsh only fill it.
